t2 = srem i64 a, 7
t3 = icmp ne i64 t2, 0
t4 = xor i64 t2, 7
t5 = icmp slt i64 t4, 0
t6 = and i1 t3, t5
t7 = select i1 t6, i64 7, i64 0
t8 = add i64 t2, t7
ret i64 t8
end
case floor_rem.i64.const-1
t1 = icmp eq i64 -1, -1
t2 = select i1 t1, i64 1, i64 -1
t3 = sdiv i64 a, t2
t4 = srem i64 a, t2
t5 = icmp ne i64 t4, 0
t6 = xor i64 t4, -1
t7 = icmp slt i64 t6, 0
t8 = and i1 t5, t7
t9 = select i1 t8, i64 -1, i64 0
t10 = add i64 t4, t9
ret i64 t10
end
case floor_rem.i64.proven
t1 = urem i64 a, b
ret i64 t1
end
case floor_rem.i64.proven-verify
t1 = icmp slt i64 a, 0
t2 = icmp sle i64 b, 0
t3 = or i1 t1, t2
trapif t3 fact
t4 = urem i64 a, b
ret i64 t4
end

ret i64 t3
